summary: Hiker reported missing in the Kit Carson Peak area; Saguache County SAR had a hasty team en route and requested AVSAR mutual aid for a 0700 Saturday rendezvous at the Baca Firehouse; just after midnight on September 15 dispatch reported the hiker had made his own way home safe and sound, and AVSAR was stood down before deploying.
responding_agency: Saguache County SAR (AVSAR mutual aid, stood down before deployment)
notes: Stand-down class: SCSAR hasty team en route, AVSAR callout issued; subject self-recovered home, AVSAR stood down before deploying. Parent-opened live run 997; stood-down-mission precedent ids 2381/3535.
